tasks.instruction: Obtain exact Tangent deck STEP/mesh and publication permission; confirm it describes this received revision.
Measure all bracket/deck hole centers, coordinate frame, edge distances and drilling uncertainty on the actual revision.
Survey deck and bracket mating surfaces, thickness and countersinks in a consistent local frame.
Record the loaded deck deformation envelope and measurement method for realistic ground and wheel clearance.
Obtain licensed revision-specific Zee Bracket solid geometry or independently acquire a calibrated scan.
Survey deck-side and truck-side threaded/through holes, centerlines, countersink surfaces and local orientation.
Locate independent fiducials on both bracket instances and record handedness and contact planes.
Resolve seller V2 versus maker V3 listing against invoice, packaging, and inspected truck baseplates before making any revision claims.
Obtain licensed 3D geometry of exact Paris variant and its baseplate, hanger, bushings and kingpin.
Survey actual truck baseplate mounting hole centers and contact plane relative to selected bracket.
Measure steering articulation, axle travel, full-stop envelope and bushing compression on the received revision.
Acquire exact wheel core plus outer profile, or perform calibrated measurements of the received 85 mm or 105 mm variant.
Measure the wheel bearing bores, depths, spacers and wheel/axle offsets, with side-by-side actual wheel samples.
Measure diameter, width and actual surface profile including any runout and relevant uncertainty.
Measure exact bearing inner/outer diameters, width, race alignment and spacer stack from received JEHU V2 pieces.
Reconcile exact bearing maker version and received count against complete kit and any axle spacers.
Reconcile physical fastener count and package revision against maker advertised kit, without creating separate orders.
Record fastener length, head profile, thread and engagement through the observed deck/bracket stack.
Reconcile received truck hardware and washers/lock nuts against source claims and actual truck revisions.
Measure baseplate hardware, bolt protrusion, wrench clearance and thread engagement at the actual bracket interface.

interfaces.check: Aligned hole centers, mounting planes, countersink shape, fastener reach and bracket handedness
Actual Paris baseplate revision, hole/face alignment and bracket orientation
Axle diameter, spacer order, bearing seats, wheel offset and nut engagement
Dynamic wheel-to-deck and bracket clearance at worst-case steering, suspension/bushing loads and deck deflection
Deck/bracket screw engagement, countersink fit and interference
Baseplate bolt/head protrusion, threads and available tool clearance
Loaded ground clearance and obstacle margins with wheel compression
